cash_entries_reversal_ok.name: cash_entries_reversal_ok
cash_entries_reversal_ok.value:
("cash_entries"."reversed_at" is null and "cash_entries"."reversed_by" is null and "cash_entries"."reversal_reason" is null)
        or ("cash_entries"."reversed_at" is not null and "cash_entries"."reversed_by" is not null
            and length(btrim(coalesce("cash_entries"."reversal_reason", ''))) > 0)

clients_merged_is_deleted.name: clients_merged_is_deleted
clients_merged_is_deleted.value: "clients"."merged_into_id" is null or "clients"."deleted_at" is not null

orders_confirmed_has_price.name: orders_confirmed_has_price
orders_confirmed_has_price.value: "orders"."status" in ('draft', 'cancelled') or "orders"."is_archive" or "orders"."price_per_kg_snapshot" is not null

profiles_location_required.name: profiles_location_required
profiles_location_required.value: "profiles"."role" not in ('location_lead', 'production', 'driver') or "profiles"."location_id" is not null
